name: Portora Master Quill

intro.text: As Wilde said, I can resist everything except temptation. And you, standing there, are tempting me into a battle.

win: Try again. Fail again. Fail better. Beckett said that. I'm saying it to myself now.
after: Wilde won a gold medal for Classics here. I won a mug for most improved staff five-a-side. We all have our moment.
